laws.rule: Samaria National Park (Samaria Gorge) opens seasonally; the 2026 season opened on 19 May. Adult entry in 2026 was EUR 10 (about A$15.89, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), with under-18s and over-65s free. Tickets are sold on the park's official ticket site.
